text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Former prime minister Edward Fenech Adami overwhelmingly confirmed as Nationalist Party leader. Fenech Adami last week assumed personal responsibility for party's electoral defeat on October 26 after nine years in power, and requested secret vote on his party leadership.
- Lohombus Bank posts record profit of $5.8 million before tax in financial year ended September.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant tells Labour Party activists government will act carefully, with no rash decisions.
- Thieves steal Lm500,000 ($1.3m) in raid on Group 4 security firm.
- Austrian bank opens offshore subsidiary in Malta.
